name: InterContinental Fujairah Resort
positioning: Beach resort on Al Aqah Beach on the Fujairah coast, with the Hajar Mountains behind it, Indian Ocean views from every room, four pools and O Spa by L'Occitane
best_for: Couples and families who want a beach and pool resort with mountain and ocean scenery
Snorkellers and water-sports fans heading to Snoopy Island
Spa-goers drawn to Provence-inspired L'Occitane treatments

facts.text: The resort is set along Al Aqah Beach with the Hajar Mountains behind it and overlooks the Indian Ocean.
The resort is on a secluded stretch of Al Aqah Beach, where the shoreline opens wide to the Indian Ocean with the Hajar Mountains just beyond.
Every room and suite opens to uninterrupted Indian Ocean views.
Classic Rooms combine contemporary comfort with Arabian-inspired craftsmanship and have a private balcony.
Guests can begin the day with a guided yoga session beside the Indian Ocean.
Planet Trekkers Kids Club offers supervised indoor and outdoor activities for younger guests, including arts and crafts, games, movies and reading areas.
Curated water experiences include snorkelling, paddleboarding and parasailing.
Snoopy Island, about 6.5 kilometers from the hotel, is a haven for snorkelling, kayaking and swimming, with coral reefs home to marine life including rays and sea turtles.
Club InterContinental offers exclusive lounge access, personalised service, curated culinary presentations throughout the day and dedicated check-in.
NAMA Global Dining is the resort's main restaurant, offering all-day dining with international flavours in an ocean-facing setting.
Al-Bidyah Mosque, the UAE's oldest mosque, is about 8.3 kilometers from the hotel.

highlights.text: O Spa by L'Occitane offers Provence-inspired wellness rituals and is the first L'Occitane spa in the Northern Emirates.
Four temperature-controlled pools trace the coastline, including an infinity pool that stretches toward the Indian Ocean, family areas and a secluded Club pool.
Presidential Suites of up to 245 square meters offer private living and dining areas and panoramic terraces.
The spa has generous treatment areas, calming relaxation spaces and an open, airy design, framed by the Al Aqah coastline and Hajar Mountains.

considerations.text: The resort is around 90 minutes from Dubai, and Dubai International Airport is about 151 kilometers away.
Fujairah Fort is about 47.5 kilometers from the hotel.
